restaurant.name: Kaffberry
restaurant.subTagline: Jammu's sanctuary of quiet luxury — single-origin pour-overs, golden viennoiserie, 48-hour fermented sourdough pizzas, and handmade bronze-die pasta in the heart of Channi Himmat.
restaurant.concept: An upscale, contemporary European cafe and artisan patisserie where third-wave specialty coffees, flaky French pastries, hand-tossed Neapolitan pizzas, and refined bistro plates are celebrated with understated elegance.

location.landmarks: Sector 2 Main Avenue, 100 meters from Channi Himmat Central Park, 3 minutes from Wave Mall & NH-44 highway bypass

hours.breakfast: 09:30 AM – 12:30 PM (Viennoiserie, eggs benedict, specialty espresso)
hours.bistroDining: 12:30 PM – 11:00 PM (Neapolitan pizza, handmade pasta & mains)
hours.highTea: 04:00 PM – 07:00 PM (Artisan entremets, teas & single-origin pour-overs)

marketAnalysis.locationContext: Located in the quiet, upscale residential greenery of Sector 2 Channi Himmat, Kaffberry caters to Jammu's discerning connoisseurs, creative professionals, doctors, civil servants, and well-traveled families. Just minutes away from Narwal bypass and Wave Mall, yet tucked away from traffic noise, it offers a serene, sunlit European retreat that effortlessly transitions into an intimate, dimly lit evening bistro.

culinaryPillars.description: Ethically sourced single-origin Arabica beans roasted to highlight delicate jasmine, bergamot, stone fruit, and dark cocoa tasting notes.
Laminated with 84% French butter for featherlight honeycomb croissants, paired with naturally fermented Neapolitan pizza crusts.
Fresh durum wheat and egg yolk pastas extruded through bronze dies for silky, sauce-gripping textures.
Venetian mascarpone tiramisu, caramelized Basque burnt cheesecake, and delicate fruit tartlets.
